question: Is the grading environment controlled, so that the system under test cannot reach answers or alter the scoring?
shown_means: the grading environment and its isolation described
checked_means: isolation of the system's output from the tests and the scorer verified or enforced in code
applies_when: scoring runs the system's output as code or in an environment

applicability.reason: Scoring runs the system's patch inside the task repository and then its own test runner.

check.procedure: Read the B28a-release check: 10 candidate diffs that change only test running files were graded by the SWE-bench harness on three source runner layouts (bin/test with sympy/utilities or sympy/testing runtests.py) and one target pytest layout (conftest.py). Read SCORING_FILE and the per session control in sessions.py.
check.detection_limits: The check could not detect alterations through files outside SCORING_FILE (sympy source, test files or import hooks) or other layouts, covers four tasks, and the candidates were fixed before the session agents existed.

evidence.quote: no reference fix of the selected tasks touches them

reasons: Release level test runner mutability exists: in all four runner layouts, every candidate that changed only runner or configuration files was graded resolved without fixing any task (grading altered). POLICY-P6-CONTROLLED (no_scoring_file_changes) does not close this at release level; it applies per case, because sessions.py records for each observation whether its patch changed a SCORING_FILE and marks the session invalid if so. The control applies to every case of the 88 tasks by design, and is Admissible for a case only when that record is confirmed for each retained observation. No session has run yet, so no per observation record exists to read.
missing: Per observation no_scoring_file_changes records for the Protocol 6 sessions, which do not exist yet.
checks_performed: Read the four check.json files, NOTES.md, the check prompt, SCORING_FILE and the session control in sessions.py.
instructions: Record evidence locations with short quotes, the check performed, its outcome, detection limits, and reasons. The check outcome is the result of the check described in the procedure; state whether the benchmark sources report it or the auditor performed it. A rating without evidence and reasons is incomplete. Missing evidence is not a defect; a defect needs a cited location, and an oracle defect needs an executed counterexample.

session_control.description: Code confirms for every retained observation that its patch modifies no SCORING_FILE runner or config.
